comment: Represents the configurations of a particular overlay.

variables.name: enabled
variables.comment: Whether or not the overlay is enabled by default.

variables.name: mutable
variables.comment:
* Whether or not the overlay is mutable and can have its enabled state changed dynamically
         * using the {@code OverlayManagerService}.
         *

variables.name: policy
variables.comment: The policy granted to overlays on the partition in which the overlay is located.

variables.name: parsedInfo
variables.comment:
* Information extracted from the manifest of the overlay.
         * Null if the information was read from a config file instead of a manifest.
         *
         * @see parsedConfigFile
         *

variables.name: parsedConfigFile
variables.comment:
* The config file used to configure this overlay.
         * Null if no config file was used, in which case the overlay's manifest was used instead.
         *
         * @see parsedInfo
         *
